summary: Shawano County tower listed as gone by the FFLA; the sources read give only its county, coordinates and map entry, with no build or fire history.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; no source we found describes what remains.

evidence.supports: OpenStreetMap node named Morris Lookout Tower

sources.title: Wisconsin Lookouts - Forest Fire Lookout Association

notes_for_editor: Very thin record. The Central US Lookouts page gives only the heading and county. The FFLA list gives coordinates and gone status. The OSM node gives the name, observation tag and an elevation of 388 m (matches the record). No build date, operator, staffing or fire history was found in the cached pages or two searches. The OSM point is about 16 m from the FFLA point; the record keeps the FFLA point. The anyplaceamerica.com entry for this tower returned HTTP 403, so it was not read.
